detail: recipe_checkpoint_suffix (tools/fixtures.py) builds the 100,000-record store from a 1,000-article seed initialized with SYNTH_100K (T 131072, H 536,870,912) and capacity suffix_capacity(100000, 20000) = 244,000, checkpoints it, then POSTs 20,000 2 KiB articles. POST 17,270 (Message-ID 5017269) is refused '441 ... history-exhausted': 536,870,912 / about 118,270 articles is about 4,540 charged octets per 2,048-octet article (payload, its membership rows and header columns share H). tests/test_fixture_init_refusal.py CheckpointSuffixTests asserts that T and K hold seed + N + suffix but never H, so the recipe's sizing was not checked. The fixture was added by 64dc501b1 (09-28) and no fixture directory exists on hbox; no native reads it (its only reader is that unit test). Repair in the recipe: a seed profile whose H holds seed + N + suffix at the charged size, with the unit test asserting it from the charge (books' history charge per article, evaluated, not a hand constant); syn100k-2k and curve keep SYNTH_100K.
